limitations: Synthetic targets are not human transcription truth; transformed cases are not independent source recordings.
No physical microphone/speaker or complete chat end-to-end latency measurement.
ASR p95 improvement was not stable across rechecks; 25% engineering goal was not achieved.
TTS observed p95 tolerance is not proof of zero regression or statistical noninferiority; medium overlap first-voiced median increased about 1.72%.
Existing app remained running; no frequency lock or complete OS workload isolation.
CPU operator counts and CUDA event elapsed intervals do not establish kernel busy time or complete causal attribution.
Long audio appendix does not drive the conversational default selection; no more long-audio benchmarks planned.

selection.rationale: Short-latency benefit with official generation semantics; preserve FA2 audio routing while measured full FA2 is slower. Prefill benefit not stable; greedy incremental gain small and pooled TTS tails not within observation margin.
selection.tts_gate: Observed first-voiced/total p95 within +5% for selected official serial and overlap cases; not a statistical noninferiority proof or zero-regression claim.

operator_trace.note: CPU operator trace confirms dispatch and scalar-read counts, not CUDA kernel time or causal attribution of the latency difference.
